title: Step nine awaits its opening job and requires explicit setup checkpoint evidence
steps: Run the database-backed brief and site-route tests with an isolated scratch database.
Simulate a setup seal completing at 105 seconds, refusals and missing host receipts; return a pending backup history response.
expect: The three-minute setup budget polls one accepted job and does not submit a duplicate seal.
No scripted write starts without an explicit opening receipt, and native repairs cannot start without an explicit scripted checkpoint receipt.
Pending or failed backup reads stop writes with uncertainty preserved, rather than reporting a nonexistent full backup.
fence: Bounded same-job polling and explicit receipt gates; no backup creation bypass or write after an unproven setup hold

cmd: --test-name-pattern=required setup|explicit scripted checkpoint|chain commits scripted|missing setup hold|explicit setup budget|pending|uncertain
